resources.string: "Provider aggregate bills and run costs are displayed separately. Aggregate bills are not allocated to individual runs."
"Worktrees and local branches remain in their original locations."
"The previous request needs reconciliation. It was not sent again."
"Token counts are not inferred from ratios. Context and per-run usage are read separately. Polling stops once history is stable; reads stop when the panel closes or the app enters the background."
"Git is not reset and project files are not rewritten. The original program may keep writing its own logs."
"Future tasks cannot select this definition. Existing tasks keep their original installation, records and secret references."
"Only applies while the message version still matches and withdrawal is allowed. Stop work that has already started separately."
"Discard only this page\'s input. Original host settings stay unchanged. Passwords are not stored in local drafts."

"Ask Core to repair access permissions for managed configuration files only. Server definitions, member selections and model input stay unchanged. Reload diagnostics afterwards; a completed call does not mean the issue is resolved."
"Select a specific version already added. Install it in agent settings first."
"The unresolved original task record is preserved. Later uploads use a new ID. The original copy may already exist remotely; active tasks cannot be skipped directly."
"Use current version and discard old local plan"
"Saving affects future tasks only. The actual agent session validates the model and parameters. Failures preserve their reasons without switching models automatically."
"Saving a template does not start a task. Original program settings and materials are preserved with it and checked in the current mission when used."
"Keep the repository record and original work. Remove only the source link."
"Keep original record and start a new upload"
"Files and historical versions are preserved. Reinstalling does not restore member selection automatically."
"Keep unresolved record and create another upload…"
"Messages and history are preserved. Core handles ending active work."
"Information changed elsewhere. The current draft is preserved; close and reopen before editing."
"Candidate content has not become shared memory yet."
"Select a file, then choose each item. Nothing runs, installs programs or binds same-named members automatically."
"Preview the complete text before sending it to a member. Delivery to a connection does not mean the model has read it."
"Preview first; remove up to 20 copies per batch. Files for removed copies can be cleaned up separately."
"Closing the view keeps the terminal process running. Choose Stop to end it."
"Credentials are stored only by the host. This page does not read existing tokens; leave empty to keep the original token."
"No registered projects in this group yet"
"The groups have changed. Your input is preserved. Review the latest list before continuing."
"Groups are shared within the current workspace. Files and conversations stay in place."
"Create an independent working conversation with only the selected member. Original records are preserved; no message is sent automatically."
"When creation is unresolved, reconcile the same ID only. Do not create again or disguise read-only records as ordinary messages."
"Deleting a canvas removes its cards, regions and notes. Original conversations, missions, tasks and project files are preserved."
"Joining takes effect in future runs only. It does not start members or resume old runs."
"Historical tasks and messages are preserved. Database commits and file saves are listed separately."
"History is preserved. Runs from the previous membership period stop and open tasks become unassigned. Inviting again does not resume old runs."
"The original group change needs reconciliation. It is not resent automatically."
"The original group was removed. Old input cannot recreate it."
"The original merge request is frozen. Reconciliation reuses its request ID and does not switch to merging a newer commit."
"The original project is unavailable. Select a working directory again."
"The original submission needs reconciliation. After closing, reconcile or retry the same request in the workspace."
"The original file contains unrecognized or incomplete records. Readable records are preserved."
"The original program explicitly did not receive the input. After separate confirmation, ordinary send and queue rules for the original conversation apply."
"The original result is unresolved. Do not resend or redirect it to another task."
"The original request needs reconciliation. It was not resent automatically."
"The original request is frozen. Reconciliation reuses the same ID. If the result is unknown, check the remote side first. Closing preserves the request."
"The original request needs reconciliation. Drafts and attachments are preserved. Reconcile or retry the same request in the workspace."
"The original request needs reconciliation. Close this view to reconcile or retry it from the workspace."
"The original request needs reconciliation. The complete draft is preserved."
"The original request needs reconciliation. Current selections are preserved."
"The original request needs reconciliation. It was not sent again."
"The original request needs reconciliation. Do not save again. "
"The original request needs reconciliation. Close this view to reconcile or retry it from the workspace."
"The original request result needs reconciliation. Close this page to reconcile it in the workspace."
"The original runtime program is unavailable on this host. Save the local program settings above, then refresh connections. Old tasks keep their original connection."
"Cancellation is final. Other changes in the text draft are not submitted with it."
"Only the ID and program owner are saved. Plain environment values remain in this form only."
"Only the contents above change. Other original advanced settings and non-text materials are preserved in full."
"Merge only the commit shown here. Reload if the branch changes."
"Process only the specific previewed objects. Preserve local data, other copies and remote tombstones. After interruption, reconcile the original result first."
"Process only the items explicitly selected in this preview. Later changes prevent overwriting. Historical tasks are preserved and work does not start automatically."
"Read only saved visible text and tool names. Select sources, grant access and add them to the message, then send normally."
"Read only the current execution host\'s directory. For custom programs, use the specific version saved for the member."
"Change only records in the import library. Preserve source material."
"An additional environment may be required. Installing skills does not install dependencies automatically."
"Filling replaces the current title and description. Nothing starts before confirming mission creation."
"Enter the program path on the host. Leave empty for automatic discovery."
"Enter a directory on the host. Aliases only organize the display and do not change file access permissions."
"Review time, e.g. 2026-12-01T09:00:00+08:00; leave empty to clear"
"The conversation directory is incomplete. These results are still being checked."
"The object may have changed. Reload it."
"Submit using the selected repository account. The request is frozen after submission and preserved on failure or disconnection."
"Unsaved content will be discarded. Published memory stays unchanged."
"Saving properties does not rebind conversations or files, or overwrite positions moved on another client."
"Project relationships changed or are unverified. Reload and use the latest layout."
"The project returns to the top level. Files, missions and conversations are preserved."
"This project was removed. Its old membership is preserved; uncheck to remove that membership."
"Created tasks, historical messages and the original import archive are preserved."
"The platform did not provide a text diff"
"Select up to 200 ordinary conversation cards to group. Missions, tasks, files, terminals and notes keep their own object types."
"Responsibilities or runs still need attention. Complete the corresponding handover first."
"No valid observations of the current native session context yet"
"The ordinary input box keeps its text, materials and references. Only the complete input above is sent."
"Unsaved position and grouping changes will be replaced. No changes are submitted to the workspace."
"The unsaved property draft will be replaced. This does not submit canvas changes."
"No active task both supports native steering and has it enabled."
"The current version is newer than the original change, so the old request cannot write again. Discard only this unresolved local plan; unsaved group drafts are preserved."
"Discard the current draft and newly selected attachments. Preserve original mission attachments and published messages. Load the latest content without submitting changes."
"Current input is unsaved. New plain environment values are not written to drafts. Sent requests keep their original IDs for reconciliation."
"Both the global switch and member assignment must be enabled, and the program must support the tool. Only new tasks are affected; original Rovai tools retain their own permissions."
"The new project\'s worktree relationship is not reconciled, or this worktree follows its parent project. A new link cannot be added yet."
"Arrange positions using original card sizes. Conversations, files and card contents stay unchanged."
"Scheduled missions wait for you to start them. The host uses the selected time zone. Repeated daylight-saving times run once; nonexistent times are skipped."
"Configure member runtime parameters supported by the actual host"
"Access lasts up to two hours; preview valid until "
"Submission result needs reconciliation. Original text and ID are preserved."
"Access cannot be used after revocation. This does not send messages or start members."
"Use the current project, branch and selected members\' runtime settings. The original template is preserved."
"Discard local arrangement and load latest layout"

"Discard draft and load the latest properties?"
"Values include received observations only. Unknown does not mean zero, and normal completion does not mean the statistics are complete."
"Send complete follow-up input as an ordinary next turn"
"The complete input remains in the original preview. Sending as an ordinary next turn requires separate confirmation."
"Reconcile ownership of legacy entries in the host desktop diagnostic center before cleaning them up."
"Old material paths are not read directly. Add materials for this task, then map them individually."
"Explicit selections apply to future tasks only. Existing tasks keep their original provider version."
"Ordinary input and other materials are preserved."
"An original save request remains from an older editor. Reconcile its result first."
"Unsaved address, model and secret inputs will be discarded."
"The original request is preserved. Another upload is not created automatically."
"The source binding stays fixed. Existing file permissions still apply when reading."
"View host status and export a redacted report"
"This worktree follows its main project’s group."
"Each canvas has its own regions, conversation cards, notes, files and terminals."
"Uses original Codeg themes, colors and previews"
"Uses the original distribution configuration. Install explicitly after saving; existing tasks keep their original version."
"New environment values remain on this page only. Saved values are shown as secret references."
"Applies to future runs. Actual levels depend on runtime feedback."
"Applies to the member\'s new tasks. Deselecting does not rewrite old tasks."
"The canvas stores layout and references. Deleting a node keeps its project, conversation and files."
"The canvas was updated. Input is preserved."
"The canvas was updated. Close this view, check the latest card and try again."
"The canvas has other changes. Reload before proceeding."
"The canvas has new changes. Current input is preserved. Reconcile before continuing."
"The canvas version changed. The current draft is preserved. Load the latest properties before editing again."
"The target version changed. This suggestion can only be rejected."
"Historical identity and records are preserved after removal."
"Tasks in a final state cannot be changed."
"The result is too long. Some content has been permanently omitted."
"Inherit leaves the base model unchanged. The actual program still validates directories and supported options."
"Editing was interrupted. Take over from the queued message\'s saved version or discard these edits."
"Missing observations remain gaps. Explicit zero values are shown on the baseline."
"Custom groups remove their original members. Automatic project and member regions preserve their derived relationships. Actual conversations and files are not moved."
"A member in the draft is unavailable"
"This large record was fully verified and saved as a temporary file. Export it to view the complete content or open it on the desktop."
"Save or cancel the runtime settings above first."
"Select a configured agent first. Models and permissions depend on options supported by the actual host."
"Read host dependencies, managed content and agent status. Core redacts exports centrally. Exports exclude messages, memory text, attachment contents and tool output."
"Adjust standalone host diagnostic log detail. Original failure records, run status, approvals and operation receipts are preserved."
"The original program consumed this input. Do not queue it again. Direct steering is disabled for this connection."
"No import records yet. Select a native conversation folder on the desktop to import."
"No providers yet. Add one, then explicitly select it in the member\'s runtime settings."
"No templates yet. Create or migrate them in host configuration migration and template settings."
"No custom agents yet. Add an ACP program, then select it in member settings."
"This source has no continuation or fork records yet."
"This host\'s log settings are managed by its desktop application. Change them in the host desktop settings."
"This is the last successful record. Current status has not been reconfirmed."
"This only reads original records; it does not resend. Delivery to a connection or receipt from the program does not mean the model has read it."
"After connecting, use conversations, missions, members and projects on the server."
"The connected host uses this account to save encrypted copies. Leave the password empty to keep the current account password."
"Connection settings, encrypted copies and original transfer status"
"Selection only fills the input box. You decide when to send."
"Long-press text to select a passage. Quotes preserve the snapshot at selection time. Capture is rejected if the original message changes."
"Change the team and leader in the original management view. Saving new mentions in the description invites those members."
"Member information changed. Current edits are preserved. Go back and reopen."
"The project arrangement has new changes. The current layout draft is preserved."
"Only interface preferences upload by default. Select complete configuration and secrets separately. Each item must still be selected on another host after download; nothing starts automatically."
"Off by default. Applies to future tasks only and requires actual connection support."
"Off by default. Once enabled, applies to new tasks and is received only when the member actively checks."
